tianxia.talent.ink.living_illustration.reviewed_by: AUTO138: summon form benefits belong to the Painted Beast, not its writer or surrounding creatures

effects.name: ink_illustration_training
effects.evidence: Each time you create a Painted Beast, choose one form benefit.

riders: Spider climbing, Horse passenger capacity, and Hound tracking/detection checks need movement and check support. Their other form benefits are automated.

insight.living-illustration-adept.reviewed_by: AUTO138: +2 AC, +2 x CL HP, and an additional distinct form selection

effects.name: ink_illustration_adept
effects.evidence: Painted Beast gains +2 AC, additional HP equal to 2 x your CL, and one additional form benefit from Living Illustration.

riders: Spider climbing, Horse passenger capacity, and Hound tracking/detection checks remain manual, as for Living Illustration.
